title: Public demo page (/apercu)
problem: The marcportal.com project gallery embeds this app in a sandboxed iframe, but every anonymous visit 307s to /login — the portfolio card only ever showed a login form. Strangers had no way to feel the core loop (stamp, trim, version) without a Google sign-in and a band.
analysis: Every clip view already takes serializable props, and useWaveSurfer accepts any URL. A static page can therefore feed the REAL WaveformPlayer canned data plus a bundled audio file, with zero reach into auth, Prisma, Drive or FFmpeg. The only blockers were the hardcoded /api/audio/:id URL (now an optional audioUrl prop), the proxy matcher, and avoiding ClipDetailClient's polling Team tab.
implementation: app/apercu/page.tsx (outside app/(auth)) renders components/apercu/ApercuClient.tsx: three canned clips from lib/apercuDemo.ts over one generated 72s jam (public/demo/jam.mp3 — synthesized, license-free), each with stamps and a version chain whose cutMarks drive the real cut-masking playback. proxy.ts excludes apercu|demo from the session check. Static vote tallies; the sign-in CTA routes to /login.

decisions.decision: Compose safe primitives instead of reusing ClipDetailClient
decisions.rationale: ClipDetailClient's Team tab polls votes/comments every few seconds and its action bar PATCHes — all of which 307 to /login for an anonymous visitor and fail JSON parsing. A thin page over WaveformPlayer keeps the demo path free of any network call that can fail.

decisions.decision: Generated audio instead of a licensed sample
decisions.rationale: public/demo/jam.mp3 is synthesized by a throwaway script (bass riff, kick, hats, late lead) — recognizably a jam, zero license baggage, ~1.1 MB.

decisions.decision: audioUrl prop on WaveformPlayer, duration-PATCH skipped when set
decisions.rationale: The player hardcoded /api/audio/:id and PATCHed the clip row when durations drifted. A static file has no row to patch; the prop keeps the authed path byte-identical while letting the demo (and any future static use) point elsewhere.

successCriteria: An anonymous visit to /apercu (direct or inside the marcportal.com card iframe) plays the jam, jumps to stamps, and switching Riff in E to v2 audibly skips the masked intro — with zero 3xx/4xx/5xx requests on the page.
knownLimitations: The demo audio is one shared file across the three fake clips; only stamps and cuts differ
Votes and comments are static tallies — the collaboration loop is described, not simulated
The record screen is not represented; a sandboxed iframe cannot get mic permission anyway
userGuide: Open /apercu (no account needed). Pick a clip, tap a stamp chip to jump to that moment, and switch between versions to hear cut regions get skipped. The real app adds recording, Drive storage, voting and frozen shareable mixes — sign in from the button at the bottom.
